title: Aero 111
notes: Official 700C table read 2026-11-01: 26-622 245 g, 29-622 275 g, 32/115-622 310 g; hooked/hookless maximum 102/73 psi (26 and 29), 95/65 psi (32); rim ranges 13-22 mm (26) and 16-25 mm (29, 32). Page: aerodynamic tread with 48 vortex-generating cavities developed with DT Swiss and Swiss Side, BlackChili compound and Vectran breaker; claims exceptional grip in wet and dry conditions. Vectran Breaker, Handmade in Germany, 2/220 TPI.
